 Power restored for hundreds of people after underground cable caused outage
 By News10NBC 
 --> 
 Power outages graphic
 ROCHESTER, N.Y. — The power is back for most of the more than 400 homes or businesses on Rochester’s northeast side that lost electricity early Wednesday morning. 
 RG&E’s power outage tracker showed outages on Upper Falls Boulevard, Clifford Avenue, North Clinton Avenue, Holland Street, and other streets around 5 a.m. You can see the latest numbers here .
 An RG&E spokesperson said an underground cable issue caused the outage. The spokesperson said crews are still working to make repairs to restore power to the remaining customers as soon as possible.
